description: This file defines a Catalyst controller for managing user-related administrative actions, including listing users, viewing user details, updating user roles, and discarding users within the Coocook project.

classes.name: Coocook::Controller::Admin::User
classes.description: Controller class handling administrative user management functions such as listing, viewing, updating, and discarding users.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Handles GET/HEAD requests to list all users with project counts, accessible to users with 'manage_users' capability.

methods.name: base
methods.description: Chained method to load user object by name, setting up context for subsequent actions.

methods.name: show
methods.description: Displays detailed information about a specific user, including roles, permissions, organization memberships, and project associations.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Handles POST requests to update user details and roles, with transaction management.

methods.name: discard
methods.description: Handles POST requests to discard (delete) a user, with optional blacklisting.
